title: Problem
description: Typed error payload shared by every /api/v1 route (RFC 9457-aligned). code is stable and machine-readable; message is human-readable and may change between versions. Status mapping: 400/422 malformed input, 401 missing or expired identity, 403 permitted object with forbidden operation, 404 used to avoid disclosing hidden object existence, 409 idempotency/content conflict, 412 stale If-Match, 429 rate limit with retry information, 503 unavailable dependency. A consistent hidden-object policy means 403 and 404 are chosen deliberately, never accidentally.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem class.

title.description: Short human title for the status class.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored by the response.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; never includes credentials, tokens or restricted record payloads.

requestId.description: Correlates with response headers and logs.

details.description: Structured field- or row-level detail for 400/422 responses.
